# Senvarico

Senvarico is a lightweight ecommerce website builder in development for small cross-border sellers with limited budgets and relatively small product catalogs.

Senvarico is still in development and is not open for use. Features, integrations, prices and limits described on this site are plans, not currently available services, and may change before launch.

Official website: https://senvarico.com
Product status: In development; not yet available for use.
No public signup, trial, live store creation or purchasable plan is available.

Planned pricing (subject to change before launch):
- Free: CNY 0/month, up to 20 SKUs.
- Small Seller: CNY 99/month, up to 100 SKUs.
- Planned platform transaction fee: 0%; payment-provider fees would be separate.

Planned capabilities, not claims of implemented or available functionality:
- No-code, SaaS-hosted store building.
- Chinese and English admin.
- PayPal and Stripe integrations.
- Multi-language and multi-currency storefronts.
- Basic product, order, page and theme management.

Intended users: solo sellers and small teams with roughly 10–100 SKUs, targeting Europe and North America.
Not intended for enterprise catalogs, complex ERP workflows or highly customized infrastructure.

Register interest by email (does not grant access): https://senvarico.com/beta

## 中文

Senvarico 是一款仍在开发、面向预算有限且 SKU 较少的跨境小卖家的轻量级独立站建站工具，暂未开放使用。
Senvarico 仍在开发，暂未开放使用。本站描述的功能、支付集成、价格和上限均为规划，并非当前可用服务，上线前可能调整。
目前不能注册使用、创建实际店铺或购买套餐。
规划定价：免费版 0 元/月、20 个 SKU；小卖家版 99 元/月、100 个 SKU；规划平台佣金 0%。均可能在上线前调整。
PayPal、Stripe、中英文后台、多语言、多币种、SaaS 托管和零代码编辑均为规划，不代表已经实现或可用。
